# Safe Routes Partnership

> > Safe Routes Partnership advances equitable active transportation through advocacy, community engagement, and policy change to create safer paths for walking, biking, and rolling.

Safe Routes Partnership is a national organization dedicated to making active transportation safe and accessible for all communities, with a particular focus on equity, youth engagement, and underserved populations. The organization combines advocacy, community programs, and partnerships to transform transportation infrastructure and policy.

## Key Topics

- Active Transportation
- Safe Routes to School
- Transportation Equity
- Community Engagement
- Walking & Biking
- School Safety
- Mobility Justice
- Public Health
- Transportation Policy
- Youth Advocacy
- Infrastructure
- Racial Justice
- Community-Based Programs
- Partnerships
- Policy Advocacy
